summary: Completed comprehensive testing of JobLink MVP with new email verification, password reset, and avatar upload features. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate), most frontend features functional, but OpenGraph meta tags have React Helmet compatibility issue with React 19.

ui_bugs.issue: Webpack dev server overlay intercepts clicks preventing view profile button interaction

integration_issues.flow: OpenGraph meta tags on public profile
integration_issues.issue: React Helmet not rendering meta tags due to React 19 compatibility issue - using UNSAFE_componentWillMount

passed_tests: All 16 backend API endpoints working (100% success rate)
User registration with email verification flow initiated
Email verification page handles invalid tokens correctly
Forgot password page and form submission working
Reset password page loads and handles invalid tokens
Verification banner displays for unverified users
Avatar upload UI components present and functional
Profile form updates (name, title, bio, username, WhatsApp)
Profile link card displays with copy functionality
Public profile displays correctly with all user data
Portfolio section shows added links on public profile
WhatsApp and Apply buttons present on public profile
Navigation between login, forgot password, and verification pages
Forgot password link properly placed on login page
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix OpenGraph meta tags issue by upgrading from react-helmet to react-helmet-async which is compatible with React 19, or consider downgrading React to 18.x. Also investigate webpack dev server overlay interference with UI interactions.
